title: Intro to AI Arcade
intro: Test your AI basics! Answer quick questions and match the concepts. Get them right on the first try to earn ⭐⭐⭐!

options: Machines doing tasks that normally need human intelligence
rounds.explain: AI is about machines performing 'smart' tasks — recognizing, understanding, deciding, and learning.

rounds.prompt: Which type of AI do we actually have today?
rounds.explain: Today's AI is all Narrow AI — great at one task. General and Super AI don't exist yet.

rounds.prompt: Which is an example of AI?
rounds.explain: Recommendations learn from your behavior — that's AI. Calculators and doors just follow fixed rules.

rounds.prompt: Match each example to its AI type.
rounds.explain: Almost everything today is Narrow AI; General and Super AI are still future concepts.

rounds.prompt: How does modern AI mostly learn?
rounds.explain: Modern AI learns patterns from large amounts of data — like practicing with many examples.
